programs.title: Leopard Kingdom
programs.desc: Karula the leopard was the queen of the Sabi Sand reserve for a decade.During this time, she had to face hunger, drought and predators that wanted to take over her territory.These ten years were also full of joyful events - the leopard had six children and five grandchildren.After Karula's death, her three eldest daughters - Thandi, Shadow and Xongile - want to take over their mother's legacy.Only one of them can win and she will become queen.Soon a new player appears on the horizon.In the face of danger, the sisters unite forces.A story about the constant fight between representatives of African fauna.
